title: Line Crew Inspection Practice — Idle-Period Inspection on Electric Service by Rate Schedule Seasonal Restores
content:
**Practice.** A meter that has stood idle is inspected when the Electric Service by Rate Schedule account is restored, and the restore adds an idle-period inspection charge to the restore fee according to how long the account has stood idle, in whole months counted from the idle date to the current date. The schedule's minimum idle period is 3 calendar months on Schedule RS and 4 calendar months on Schedule IR (3 on the schedules that allow no idle).

| Whole months idle | Added to the restore fee |
|---|---|
| Six or more | $40.00 |
| The schedule's minimum idle period or more, and fewer than six | $20.00 |
| Fewer than the schedule's minimum idle period | Nothing |

### Boundary cases (hypothetical)

| Account | Whole months idle | Inspection charge |
|---|---|---|
| Schedule RS cabin | 2 | Nothing |
| Schedule RS cabin | 3 | $20.00 |
| Schedule IR pivot | 3 | Nothing |
| Schedule IR pivot | 4 | $20.00 |
| Schedule IR pivot | 5 | $20.00 |
| Either schedule | 6 | $40.00 |
